reviewFixInterpretation.q5: Stressed-cap B1 full-frame, interior-far, and blur-spread checks pass. Same-cap Full32/Full64 convergence still fails, so Q5 remains reference-not-converged.
reviewFixInterpretation.q1q6: Both use their own interior-far Full32/Full64 ROI. The 3,200 mm 4x state has no depth-edge ROI; it remains unqualified because its own interior-far references exceed frozen limits.
reviewFixInterpretation.q3: Bounded qualification applies only to the tested signed near/far boundary population and optical state. It does not qualify geometric depth-edge output, universal B1 quality, R4 parity, or production use.
